recording.note: The primary Symposium track-list scan identifies the historical commercial Gramophone disc 045578, matrix 1120m, in its 1916 chronology; the Archive instead prints 045678, and that catalogue discrepancy is preserved. The original acoustic commercial issue predates 1963, so the former European 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. The source rights year 1916 identifies that historical carrier chronology, not an independently established exact first-release date. The 1993 compilation is not represented as the original publication, and the uploader’s Public Domain Mark is not treated as a rights-owner release. No NC condition appears in the consulted source metadata.

rights.creditLine: Eugen d’Albert, piano; Gramophone matrix 1120m (1916), original catalogue 045578 in the printed discography / 045678 in Archive metadata. Symposium 1146 reissue via Internet Archive. Territorial EU public-domain recording basis; US publication status not established. Transfer engineer and processing unknown.
